name: Engineering calculators
about: The mechanical engineer's calculators (like an ME consultant): bolts and screws, shafts, gears, belts, lead screws, wheeled robots, robot-arm / servo torque, beams, columns, springs, bearings, ISO fits and printed fits, heat expansion, weight, motors, drops, 3D-printer calibration (e-steps, Klipper rotation_distance, flow) and unit conversion.
description: Exact mechanical-engineering numbers: bolt torque / strength, power-torque-rpm, shaft size, gear pair, timing belt, lead screw, robot wheels / slope, arm & servo torque, beam / shelf bending, column buckling, springs, bearing life, ISO 286 fits (H7/g6…) and printed fits, thermal expansion, weight, motor KV, drop impact, e-steps / rotation_distance / flow calibration, unit conversion. Use it whenever an answer needs a number — don't guess.
instructions:
Pick ONE calculator and fill its inputs from the request. Write every value WITH its unit as text ("20 mm", "5 kg", "2 Nm", "1500 rpm"). Leave out what the user didn't say (the calculator assumes sensible defaults and says so). Calculators and their inputs:
- bolt: size ("M6"), grade ("8.8", "10.9", "A2-70"), lube (dry / oiled / zinc / wax), into (steel / aluminium / plastic / insert / wood), load ("300 kg"), count, load_type (tension / shear)
- power: power, torque, rpm, force, speed (any two)
- shaft: torque, bending, material, diameter, length
- gears: teeth1, teeth2, module, center_distance, rpm, torque, power, face_width, material (pla, petg, nylon, steel…)
- belt: belt (GT2, HTD5M…), teeth1, teeth2 (or diameter1, diameter2), center_distance or belt_length, rpm, microsteps
- leadscrew: screw ("T8x8", "Tr10x2", "SFU1605 ball"), lead, torque, force, mass, rpm
- wheels: mass, wheel_diameter, wheels, driven, slope (deg), speed, surface (floor / grass / gravel / sand), cog_height, wheelbase, track
- arm (WHICH SERVO / STEPPER for a robot arm, a lever or any joint that holds a weight): links ("200, 150 mm") or length, link_masses or arm_mass, payload, joint_masses
- beam: length, load, support (cantilever / simple / fixed), load_type (point / uniform), section ("20x40 mm" or shape round / tube / box), width, height, diameter, wall, material
- column: length, section / diameter / width+height, ends (pinned / fixed-free / fixed-fixed), material, load
- spring: wire, outer_diameter, coils, free_length, force or deflection, rate, material (music / stainless)
- bearing: bearing ("608", "6201"), radial, axial, rpm, hours
- fit: size ("25 mm"), fit ("H7/g6" or press / sliding / running / loose), process (machined / printed)
- thermal: material, length, from, to (or delta_t)
- weight: material, shape (plate / rod / tube / sphere), size ("200x100x5 mm") or diameter + length (+ wall)
- drop: mass, height
- motor (a brushless motor's KV or a brushed DC motor — NOT for choosing a servo): kv, voltage (or "4S"), current, gear_ratio — or stall_torque + no_load_rpm
- esteps: steps_per_mm (or rotation_distance), requested ("100 mm"), actual
- rotation_distance: belt + teeth, or lead, or steps_per_mm; microsteps
- flow_calibration: expected, measured, flow
- volumetric_flow: speed ("150 mm/s"), layer_height, line_width
- convert: value ("20 kg cm"), to ("Nm")
Example: {"calc": "bolt", "inputs": {"size": "M8", "grade": "10.9", "lube": "oiled"}}. Answer with the JSON only.
